colophon.en: An account of Alma and the people of the Lord, who were driven into the wilderness by the people of King Noah. Comprising chapters 23 and 24.
colophon.sm: O se tala ia Alema ma tagata o le Alii, o ē na tutuli i le vao e le nuu o le Tupu o Noa. E aofia ai le mataupu 23 ma le 24.

words.en: and the people of the Lord,

heading.en: Alma refuses to be king—He serves as high priest—The Lord chastens His people, and the Lamanites conquer the land of Helam—Amulon, leader of King Noah's wicked priests, rules subject to the Lamanite monarch. About 145–121 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua teena e Alema le avea o ia ma tupu—Ua auauna atu o ia o se faitaulaga sili—Ua a'oa'i e le Alii Lona nuu, ma ua manumalo sa Lamanā i le laueleele o Helama—O Amulona, le taitai o faitaulaga amioleaga a Noa, ua pule o ia i lalo o le pulega a le monaki sa Lamanā. E tusa o le 145–121 T.L.M.

verses.en: Now Alma, having been warned of the Lord that the armies of king Noah would come upon them, and having made it known to his people, therefore they gathered together their flocks, and took of their grain, and departed into the wilderness before the armies of king Noah.
verses.sm: O lenei o Alema, ina ua lapata’ia o ia e le Alii o le a o mai autau a le tupu o Noa e osofa’ia i latou, ma ina ua uma ona faailoa atu i ona tagata, o lea na latou faapotopoto faatasi ai a latou lafu, ma ave a latou saito, ma o ese atu i le vao ae le’i oo mai ’autau a le tupu o Noa.

verses.en: And the Lord did strengthen them, that the people of king Noah could not overtake them to destroy them.
verses.sm: Ma sa faamalolosi i latou e le Alii, ma sa lē mafai e tagata o le tupu o Noa ona maua mai i latou e faaumatia i latou.

verses.en: And they fled eight days’ journey into the wilderness.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou sosola i le vao i se malaga i aso e valu.

verses.en: And they came to a land, yea, even a very beautiful and pleasant land, a land of pure water.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou taunuu i se laueleele, ioe, o se laueleele matagofie tele ma lafulemu, o se laueleele o vai mamā.

verses.en: And they pitched their tents, and began to till the ground, and began to build buildings; yea, they were industrious, and did labor exceedingly.
verses.sm: Ma sa latou faatutu o latou faleie, ma amata ona galuea’iina le eleele, ma amata ona fausia fale; ioe, sa latou toaaga, ma galulue malolosi.

verses.en: And the people were desirous that Alma should be their king, for he was beloved by his people.
verses.sm: Ma sa mananao le nuu ia avea Alema ma o latou tupu, ona sa pele o ia i lona nuu.

verses.en: But he said unto them: Behold, it is not expedient that we should have a king; for thus saith the Lord: Ye shall not esteem one flesh above another, or one man shall not think himself above another; therefore I say unto you it is not expedient that ye should have a king.
verses.sm: Peitai sa fai atu o ia ia te i latou: Faauta e lē tatau ona i ai o se tupu ia te i tatou; ona ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii: ’Aua tou te faasili i o outou manatu le tasi tagata i le isi tagata; pe manatu se tagata e toatasi ua sili o ia lava i luga atu o se isi tagata; o lea Ou te fai atu ai ia te outou e lē tatau ona i ai so outou tupu.

verses.en: Nevertheless, if it were possible that ye could always have just men to be your kings it would be well for you to have a king.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, a na faapea e mafai ona outou maua pea ni tagata amiotonu e avea mo o outou tupu e lelei ona fai o so outou tupu.

verses.en: But remember the iniquity of king Noah and his priests; and I myself was caught in a snare, and did many things which were abominable in the sight of the Lord, which caused me sore repentance;
verses.sm: Ae ia manatua le amioletonu o le tupu o Noa ma ana faitaulaga; ma sa maua foi a’u lava ia i se mailei, ma ou faia mea e tele sa inosia i le silafaga a le Alii, na oo mai ai ia te a’u le salamo tigā.

verses.en: Nevertheless, after much tribulation, the Lord did hear my cries, and did answer my prayers, and has made me an instrument in his hands in bringing so many of you to a knowledge of his truth.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ina ua mavae lo’u puapuaga tele, sa oo ina faafofoga mai le Alii i a’u tagi, ma tali mai i a’u talosaga, ma ua faia a’u e ia o se meafaigaluega i ona aao i le aumaia o le toatele na’ua o outou i se malamalama o lana upumoni.

verses.en: Nevertheless, in this I do not glory, for I am unworthy to glory of myself.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea, ou te lē mitamita i lenei mea, ona ua ou lē agavaa ou te mitamita ia te a’u lava ia.

verses.en: And now I say unto you, ye have been oppressed by king Noah, and have been in bondage to him and his priests, and have been brought into iniquity by them; therefore ye were bound with the bands of iniquity.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei ou te fai atu ia te outou, sa sauāina outou e le tupu o Noa, ma sa outou pologa ia te ia ma ana faitaulaga, ma sa aumai outou i le amioletonu e i latou; o lea na noanoatia ai outou i noanoaga o le amioletonu.

verses.en: And now as ye have been delivered by the power of God out of these bonds; yea, even out of the hands of king Noah and his people, and also from the bonds of iniquity, even so I desire that ye should stand fast in this liberty wherewith ye have been made free, and that ye trust no man to be a king over you.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei e pei ona laveaiina outou e le mana a le Atua mai nei noanoaga; ioe, i fafo lava mai lima o le tupu o Noa ma ona tagata, ma mai noanoaga foi o le amioletonu, ua faapea foi ona ou manao ia outou tutulai mausalī i lenei saolotoga ua faasaolotoina ai outou, ma ia outou lē faalagolago i se tagata ia avea ma tupu i o outou luga.

verses.en: And also trust no one to be your teacher nor your minister, except he be a man of God, walking in his ways and keeping his commandments.
verses.sm: O lenei foi ia outou lē faalagolago i se tasi e avea ma o outou aoao po o so outou faifeau, vagana ai o ia o se tagata o le Atua, o loo savali i ona ala ma tausi i ana poloaiga.

verses.en: Thus did Alma teach his people, that every man should love his neighbor as himself, that there should be no contention among them.
verses.sm: Sa faapea ona aoao e Alema lona nuu, ia alofa tagata taitoatasi i lē la te tuaoi e pei o ia lava ia te ia, ina ia leai se finauga i totonu o i latou.

verses.en: And now, Alma was their high priest, he being the founder of their church.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, sa avea Alema ma o latou faitaulaga sili, ona o ia na faavaeina la latou ekalesia.

verses.en: And it came to pass that none received authority to preach or to teach except it were by him from God. Therefore he consecrated all their priests and all their teachers; and none were consecrated except they were just men.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina sa leai se tasi ua faaee i ai le pule e tala’i pe a’oa’o atu ai vaganā ai ua ia te ia mai le Atua. O lea sa faauu ai e ia o latou faitaulaga uma ma o latou a’oa’o uma; ma sa leai ni isi na faauuina vaganā ai o i latou o ni tagata amiotonu.

verses.en: Therefore they did watch over their people, and did nourish them with things pertaining to righteousness.
verses.sm: O lea sa latou leoleo ai i lo latou nuu, ma tausi i latou i mea tau i le amiotonu.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they began to prosper exceedingly in the land; and they called the land Helam.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina amata ona latou manuia tele i le laueleele; ma sa latou faaigoaina le laueleele o Helama.

verses.en: And it came to pass that they did multiply and prosper exceedingly in the land of Helam; and they built a city, which they called the city of Helam.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina latou uluuluola ma manuia tele i le laueleele o Helama; ma sa latou faatuina se aai, lea sa latou faaigoaina o le aai o Helama.

verses.en: Nevertheless the Lord seeth fit to chasten his people; yea, he trieth their patience and their faith.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea sa finagalo le Alii e talafeagai ona a’oa’iina ona tagata; ioe, sa ia tofotofoina lo latou onosai ma lo latou faatuatua.

verses.en: Nevertheless—whosoever putteth his trust in him the same shall be lifted up at the last day. Yea, and thus it was with this people.
verses.sm: Ae ui i lea— soo se tasi e tuu atu lona faalagolago ia te ia o ia lava lea o le a sii a’e i le aso gataaga. Ioe, ma sa faapea lava ona faia i lenei nuu.

verses.en: For behold, I will show unto you that they were brought into bondage, and none could deliver them but the Lord their God, yea, even the God of Abraham and Isaac and of Jacob.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, o le a ou faaali atu ia te outou sa aumai i latou i le pologa, ma sa leai se tasi sa mafai ona lavea’ia i latou ua na’o le Alii lava lo latou Atua, ioe, le Atua lava lea o Aperaamo ma Isaako ma Iakopo.

verses.en: And it came to pass that he did deliver them, and he did show forth his mighty power unto them, and great were their rejoicings.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina lavea’iina lava i latou e ia, ma faaali mai e ia lona mana malosi ia te i latou, ma sa tele lava lo latou olioli.

verses.en: For behold, it came to pass that while they were in the land of Helam, yea, in the city of Helam, while tilling the land round about, behold an army of the Lamanites was in the borders of the land.
verses.sm: Auā faauta, sa oo ina a’o i ai i latou i le laueleele o Helama, ioe, i le aai o Helama, a’o latou galuea’iina le laueleele o faataamilo ai, faauta sa i ai se ’autau a sa Lamanā i tuaoi o le laueleele.

verses.en: Now it came to pass that the brethren of Alma fled from their fields, and gathered themselves together in the city of Helam; and they were much frightened because of the appearance of the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma o lenei sa oo ina sosola uso o Alema mai o latou fanua, ma latou faapotopoto faatasi i latou lava i le aai o Helama; ma sa latou fefefe tele ona o le oo mai o sa Lamanā.

verses.en: But Alma went forth and stood among them, and exhorted them that they should not be frightened, but that they should remember the Lord their God and he would deliver them.
verses.sm: Peitai sa alu atu Alema ma ua tu i totonu o i latou, ma apoapoai atu ia te i latou ia aua ne’i o latou fefefe, ae ia latou manatua le Alii lo latou Atua ma o le a ia lavea’iina i latou.

verses.en: Therefore they hushed their fears, and began to cry unto the Lord that he would soften the hearts of the Lamanites, that they would spare them, and their wives, and their children.
verses.sm: O lea na latou faato’afilemu ai lo latou matata’u, ma amata ona latou tagi atu i le Alii ia faamalūlūina e ia loto o sa Lamanā, ina ia latou faasaoina i latou, ma a latou avā, ma a latou fanau.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lord did soften the hearts of the Lamanites. And Alma and his brethren went forth and delivered themselves up into their hands; and the Lamanites took possession of the land of Helam.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina faamalūlūina e le Alii loto o sa Lamanā. Ma sa o atu Alema ma ona uso ma tuu atu i latou lava i o latou lima; ma sa ave e sa Lamanā le laueleele o Helama mo i latou.

verses.en: Now the armies of the Lamanites, which had followed after the people of king Limhi, had been lost in the wilderness for many days.
verses.sm: O lenei o ’autau a sa Lamanā, ia sa tuliloaina mai le nuu o le tupu o Limae, sa sē i le vao mo aso e tele.

verses.en: And behold, they had found those priests of king Noah, in a place which they called Amulon; and they had begun to possess the land of Amulon and had begun to till the ground.
verses.sm: Ma faauta sa latou maua na faitaulaga a le tupu o Noa, i se nofoaga sa latou faaigoaina o Amulona; ma sa amata ona latou fai mo i latou le laueleele o Amulona ma amata ona latou galuea’iina le laueleele.

verses.en: Now the name of the leader of those priests was Amulon.
verses.sm: O lenei o le igoa o le ta’ita’i o na faitaulaga, o Amulona.

verses.en: And it came to pass that Amulon did plead with the Lamanites; and he also sent forth their wives, who were the daughters of the  Lamanites, to plead with their brethren, that they should not destroy their husbands.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina ’aioi atu Amulona ia sa Lamanā; ma sa auina atu foi e ia a latou avā, o e o afafine o sa Lamanā, e ’aioi atu i o latou tuagane, ia latou lē faaumatiaina a latou tane.

verses.en: And the Lamanites had compassion on Amulon and his brethren, and did not destroy them, because of their wives.
verses.sm: Ma sa alofagia Amulona ma ona uso e sa Lamanā, ma sa latou lē faaumatiaina i latou, ona o a latou avā.

verses.en: And Amulon and his brethren did join the Lamanites, and they were traveling in the wilderness in search of the land of Nephi when they discovered the land of Helam, which was possessed by Alma and his brethren.
verses.sm: Ma sa ’au atu Amulona ma ona uso faatasi ma sa Lamanā, ma sa latou malaga atu i le vao e su’e le laueleele o Nifae ae latou maua ai le laueleele o Helama, lea sa nonofo ai Alema ma ona uso.

verses.en: And it came to pass that the Lamanites promised unto Alma and his brethren, that if they would show them the way which led to the land of Nephi that they would grant unto them their lives and their liberty.
verses.sm: Ma sa oo ina folafola mai e sa Lamanā ia Alema ma ona uso, afai latou te faaali atu ia te i latou le ala e tau atu i le laueleele o Nifae, o le a latou tuu atu ia te i latou o latou ola ma lo latou saolotoga.

verses.en: But after Alma had shown them the way that led to the land of Nephi the Lamanites would not keep their promise; but they set guards round about the land of Helam, over Alma and his brethren.
verses.sm: Ae ina ua uma ona faaali atu e Alema ia te i latou le ala i le laueleele o Nifae, sa lē tausia e sa Lamanā la latou folafolaga; a ua latou faatulaga faataamilo leoleo i le laueleele o Helama, i luga o Alema ma ona uso.

verses.en: And the remainder of them went to the land of Nephi; and a part of them returned to the land of Helam, and also brought with them the wives and the children of the guards who had been left in the land.
verses.sm: Ma o le vaega na totoe o i latou sa o atu i le laueleele o Nifae; ma o se vaega o i latou ia, sa toe foi mai i le laueleele o Helama, ma sa latou aumai foi faatasi ma i latou avā ma fanau a leoleo o ē sa tuu i le laueleele.

verses.en: And the king of the Lamanites had granted unto Amulon that he should be a king and a ruler over his people, who were in the land of Helam; nevertheless he should have no power to do anything contrary to the will of the king of the Lamanites.
verses.sm: Ma sa tuu atu e le tupu o sa Lamanā ia Amulona ia avea o ia ma tupu ma pule i luga o ona tagata, o ē sa i le laueleele o Helama; ae ui i lea, sa lē ia te ia se malosi’aga na te faia ai soo se mea, e lē tusa ai ma le finagalo o le tupu o sa Lamanā.
